visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a pink checkered shirt sits at a white table against a bright yellow studio wall. He holds a circular wooden board containing sliced yellow pastries, gesturing with his hand to his head while looking at the camera. A colorful gift box and individual wrapped packets are on the table. (2) Close-up shot of a gift box being opened, revealing neatly arranged colorful packets labeled 'Pork Floss Cake' in various colors like yellow, purple, and orange. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The man is shown in a wider studio setting, posing behind a large white vertical board. A female photographer in a black mask and a white t-shirt holds a DSLR camera, while another assistant stands nearby. Studio lighting equipment and a grey door are visible in the background. (4) Close-up of hands and a person in a brown 'BEAMS' t-shirt and grey cap using a small yellow knife to carefully carve out the center of a round, golden-brown pastry on a wooden cutting board. Pastry crumbs are scattered around. (5) The man in the pink shirt is seen eating a piece of the pastry while watching the 'surgery' process. He looks impressed and interacts with the person cutting the cake. (6) A sequence of shots shows the man holding the gift box and posing enthusiastically with the individual packets. (7) A final montage of creatively edited photos displays the man integrated with giant images of the pastries and the gift box, including one where he is looking through a hollowed-out pastry ring.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM with a strong 4/4 beat starts immediately. A male narrator begins speaking in a very enthusiastic, fast-paced tone about his love for the brand. (2) SFX of a camera shutter 'click' punctuates the transition. The BGM remains steady in the background while the narrator explains the photo shoot. (3) A new phase is triggered by a sudden metallic 'clink' and scraping sound as the 'surgery' dialogue begins. A second male voice (the 'doctor') responds with a calmer but playful tone. (4) Loud group laughter and female cheers erupt after a comedic 'pop' sound effect when the pastry center is removed. The BGM volume ducks slightly to prioritize the laughter and dialogue. (5) Narrator returns with a high-pitched, promotional delivery. SFX of a 'ding' sound accompanies the reveal of the 'surgery' result. (6) The video ends with a celebratory swelling of the BGM and a final triumphant vocal exclamation from the narrator, followed by a quick fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Behind-the-scenes Process -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Pork Floss Cake' from the brand '胖肉鋪' for the Mid-Autumn Festival. It uses a humorous 'surgery' metaphor to showcase the product's internal texture (meat floss) and the creative effort behind its marketing photography, ultimately encouraging viewers to place orders.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of brand name, showcasing gift boxes and individual products, and a call to action to 'order now'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines vlog-style behind-the-scenes humor with high-quality studio production to make a traditional food product appeal to a younger, social-media-savvy audience.
